title: DarioHealth Corp. 8-K Filing — Appointment of John R. Palumbo to Board of Directors
summary: DarioHealth Corp. (Nasdaq: DRIO) filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 announcing the appointment of John R. Palumbo, age 75, to its Board of Directors effective April 10, 2026. Palumbo brings over 40 years of healthcare operating experience and currently serves on multiple boards including Lucid Diagnostics Inc., ivWatch LLC, and Brado Ai. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: DarioHealth Corp. (DRIO) filed Form 8-K announcing board appointment of John R. Palumbo on April 10, 2026.
Palumbo, 75, appointed on recommendation of Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.
Palumbo currently serves on boards of Lucid Diagnostics Inc. (NASDAQ: LUCD), ivWatch LLC, and chairs advisory board of Brado Ai.
Palumbo brings 40+ years of healthcare operating experience across early-stage ventures and Fortune 100 enterprises.
Company's common stock trades on The Nasdaq Capital Market LLC under ticker DRIO.
Filing also includes press release as Exhibit 99.1.
No material transactions or compensatory arrangement changes disclosed beyond standard director fees.
